# ViGEmBus Redistributable

HOTASBridge bundles the official ViGEmBus 1.22.0 setup executable so users can install the virtual gamepad bus driver from inside the first-run app flow.

Bundled file:

- `ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe`
- Source: https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases/tag/v1.22.0
- SHA-256: `89220A7865076B342892F98865F3499FB7C4CFD673159E89D352C360FD014C6A`

ViGEmBus is retired/end-of-life and remains available from the archived Nefarius GitHub release. HOTASBridge does not install the driver silently; the app prompts the user and Windows elevation/UAC is required.
